## Requirements (from the contract)

1. `scripts/bm-row.sh <ID>…` — one row per id: `DF-*` → DEFERRALS.md;
   `BL-*` → BACKLOG.csv (line + header); `OQ-*` → open-questions.md;
   `CF-*` → conflicts.md; `SD-*`/spec-debt ids → spec-debt.md;
   `RK-*` → risks.md; `R-2.x.y[a-z]` → COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv row;
   `--status` prints id + lead token + last dated marker (≤400 chars);
   unknown id → exit 2. Pure bash/awk.
2. `scripts/deferrals-open.sh` — one line per DF row whose status is not
   DONE/WONTFIX (gotcha-8 detection: lead token + dated markers, robust
   to `|` inside code spans), with lead token, last dated marker
   (≤200 chars) and BL home; `--bl` lists open BL rows (id · status ·
   title ≤120 chars).
3. `scripts/spec-section.sh <R-id|AC-id|"§heading">` — one requirement
   section (`###` heading → next `###`) or one AC bullet, never more.
4. `scripts/check-bm-tools.sh` — self-test wired into CI next to
   check-drift.sh; asserts invariants only (BM-TEST-01): every id
   `deferrals-open.sh` lists resolves via `bm-row.sh` to exactly one
   row; a known DONE row is absent from the index; `spec-section.sh
   R-2.8.4` starts with its heading and contains no second `### `;
   unknown ids exit 2. No counts pinned.
5. Read-rule wording — AGENTS.md gotcha 1 + `## Build memory` bullet +
   LEDGER OPERATING MODE: "run `scripts/deferrals-open.sh`, then
   `scripts/bm-row.sh` the rows your contract names — never read
   DEFERRALS.md, BACKLOG, the registers or the spec whole
   (BM-ORIENT-01)". OPERATING MODE edit living-archived per BM-LEDGER-08
   (archive under `docs/build/reports/ledger-archive/` + sha256 pointer
   comment); CURRENT STATE lines ≤256 B.
6. ac5 class on the merged state — verify main's derivation-aware
   predicate covers the whole recurring class (any member derived from
   a prior `context.assembled` measured wall); name+cover any further
   derivable member; test still enumerates admitted members; reasoning
   in-test + dated note on the G5-7 flag.
7. Helper-spawn machinery — `check-removability.sh` detects the
   saturated-spawn timeout pattern + prints/records the override recipe
   (`HH_HELPER_SPAWN_DEADLINE_MS`/`HH_HELPER_CONNECT_DEADLINE_MS`);
   gotcha 10 points at it; defaults unchanged.
8. G5-1 — reproduce the 51-warning invocation, root-cause vs the
   7-warning steady state; dated note in
   `docs/build/planning/2026-10-20_round4-decomposition.md`
   §Accounting; fix only if the defect is in THIS repo.
